name: Healers Vest
description: Thick quilted padding stitched into a vest. Absorbs blows.

name: Padded Vest
description: Thick quilted padding stitched into a vest. Absorbs blows.

name: Chain Shirt
description: Interlocking iron rings form a flexible shirt of armour.

name: Plate Cuirass
description: Heavy forged steel chest plate. Near impenetrable — if you can move in it.

name: Minotaur Cuirass
description: A brutal cuirass fashioned from dark leather and reinforced with ivory minotaur horns. It grants exceptional poise and agility.

name: Amethyst Wardancer Cuirass
description: An exquisite silver breastplate that feels as light as silk. Pulsing with violet energy, it offers peerless protection without hindering movement.

name: Celestial Vindicator Cuirass
description: A heavy breastplate of radiant white and silver steel. Ornate yellow trims glow with celestial power, absorbing the darkest of blows.

name: Ironpeak Dwarf Cuirass
description: A powerful dwarf warrior cuirass adorned with ornate gold trim over impenetrable iron plates.

name: Sylvan Elderwood Tunic
description: An exquisite woodelf tunic glowing with inner vibrant energy, offering peerless agility.

name: Mountain Stalker Trenchcoat
description: A heavy leather coat reinforced with iron studs and lined with bear fur.

name: Aethelgard Archmage Robe
description: Ornate silk robes woven with protective runes and star-metal thread.

name: Storm-Reaver Harness
description: A brutal chestplate of overlapping iron plates, showing the scars of many battles.

name: Seraphic Grace Gown
description: A flowing white gown embroidered with golden thread, protecting the pure of heart.

name: Blood-Feather Mantle
description: A heavy crimson mantle woven from enchanted crow feathers and reinforced with arcane silk. It pulses with a dark, avian energy.
